mappedScorePages.editorialNote: Antiphon and Nunc dimittis verses on p1357, final verse on p1358; 1962 Missal repeats antiphon after each canticle verse, and the concluding doxology. Duration remains responsive to actual candle distribution.
Score survives in bound 1961 page, but its own corrections p.LXXXVI and the 1962 printed Missal omit it. Do not use its GABC for this Candlemas moment.
Full processional chant printed and Latin text found in 1962 Roman Missal p466. Avoid similar-titled office/responsory settings.

CRITICAL: 1962 printed Missale Romanum p466 explicitly retains V. Cum inducerent puerum Iesum parentes eius... despite a modern explanatory pamphlet note saying it was removed. Current reader-candlemas.v1.json has responsumVerse and it must NOT be deleted without another true primary witness.

Printed score says On re-entering the church; 1962 Missal p466 gives responsory, verse, Gloria Patri and refrain. Its exact entrance timing depends on observed physical procession, not a fixed runtime timer.

Page 582 shows second antiphon and Vulgate Psalm 46 incipit, with repeated antiphon after appointed verses.
Printed scores show first three lines as refrain and multiple additional alternating verses. GregoBase score #259 exports six GABC elements; do not equate one refrain to entire hymn.

Page 591 prints V. Cumque audisset populus... and repetition * Cum ramis. Current PALM-R05 only carries Ingrediente body. Unlike older music fragments, this is a clearly identified return responsory with verse.
